content.title: Koyo 6300-ZZ Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 10mm x 35mm x 11mm, Metal Shielded
content.short_description: Koyo 6300-ZZ single-row deep groove ball bearing with metal shields (ZZ), 10mm bore, 35mm OD, 11mm width. Dynamic load rating 8.1 kN, static load rating 3.4 kN.
content.long_description:
The Koyo 6300-ZZ is a single-row deep groove ball bearing sized for a 10 mm bore, 35 mm outer diameter, and 11 mm width, matching standard 6300-series dimensions. Both sides are fitted with metal shields (ZZ designation), which retain lubricant within the bearing housing and restrict entry of dust and debris while leaving a small clearance gap that permits low-friction rotation.

Load capacity is rated at 8.1 kN dynamic (C) and 3.4 kN static (C0), figures used to check suitability against expected radial loads and rotational duty in the target application. As a deep groove design, the 6300-ZZ carries primarily radial loads with limited axial load capability in either direction.

Use this data to cross-reference against shaft and housing bore tolerances, expected load conditions, and speed requirements before installation. The 6300-ZZ bore/OD/width combination is a common size used across general industrial machinery, motors, and power transmission equipment.
